rationale: The adaptor now reads through chdb's first-party MySQLDump format with schema taken from the dump's own CREATE TABLE, so no project code touches rows. Row-count agreement is necessary but not sufficient, so a parity tool was written to compare null counts, per-column value hashes and physical type maps across all 17 tables, with latin1/UTF-8, timezone and enum encoding named as the risks that would falsify the claim.
subject: P-21
title: Native dump reading is in place; truthfulness still needs a value-level parity run
